text: Techtronic Industries is publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange; it says the Pudwill family remains its largest shareholder, with the remaining ownership held largely by institutional investors at North American and European-owned firms. The substantial-shareholders register in its 2026 interim report records no state or fund; at 30 June 2026 it lists only asset managers (JPMorgan Chase, Bank of New York Mellon, Capital Group, BlackRock and Pandanus Associates, at 5-11% each, largely custody and lending positions).
short: TTI is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange; the Pudwill family is its largest shareholder, the rest largely institutional investors.

source.name: Techtronic Industries 2026 Interim Report – Company Profile and Substantial Shareholders' Interests
source.quote: The Pudwill family remains the company's largest shareholder, with the remaining ownership held largely by institutional investors at North American and European-owned firms. TTI is publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange
source.note: The same PDF's substantial-shareholders register (kept under section 336 of the SFO) lists, at 30 June 2026, JPMorgan Chase & Co. 11.24% long (including a 7.80% lending pool), The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation 7.45% long, The Capital Group Companies 7.13%, BlackRock, Inc. 5.10% and Pandanus Associates Inc. 5.08%. The report does not give the interim PDF a day-specific publication date; the interim results were announced in August 2026.
